query:
SELECT
                COUNT(*) as total_votes,
                COUNT(CASE WHEN vote_type = 'upvote' THEN 1 END) as upvotes,
                COUNT(CASE WHEN vote_type = 'downvote' THEN 1 END) as downvotes,
                COUNT(CASE WHEN vote_type = 'abstain' THEN 1 END) as abstains,
                COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN vote_type = 'upvote' THEN weight ELSE 0 END), 0) as upvote_weight,
                COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN vote_type = 'downvote' THEN weight ELSE 0 END), 0) as downvote_weight
            FROM votes
            WHERE target_type = $1 AND target_id = $2
